name: Hearthveil Blacksmith
artStatus: Original low-poly forge guardian with a teal metal, copper, ember, and hooded-cloth visual language. Sampled in-game combat review is coherent; character-creation preview and final artistic approval remain pending.

limits: This package has scoped live combat, equipment, cleanup, and native progression evidence, but does not yet have character-creation preview evidence or final artistic approval. Native backpack, helmet, shield, and hammer remain rigid MeshRenderer attachments outside this five-SMR package and may obscure parts of the silhouette. It does not claim other Blacksmith skinsets, weapons, apparel, player classes, culling, portraits, multiplayer, controller variants, player death, final-owner teardown, or final artistic approval.
